name: Question 5
worked_solution:
First, recall the following:

- ${J}_{1}(0)$ represents a $1\times 1$ Jordan block with $0$'s on the leading diagonal,

- ${J}_{2}(2)$ represents a $2\times 2$ Jordan block with $2$'s on the leading diagonal.

Therefore, our Jordan blocks are given by

$$
{J}_{1}(0)=[\begin{aligned}0\end{aligned}],\,{J}_{2}(2)=[\begin{aligned}2 & 1 \\ 0 & 2\end{aligned}].
$$

The composition of our Jordan blocks gives the following block diagonal matrix:

$$
{J}_{1}(0)\,⊕\,{J}_{2}(2)=[\begin{aligned}0 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 2 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 2\end{aligned}]
$$

EXPLANATION

First, recall the following:

  • J1(0) represents a 1×1 Jordan block with 0's on the leading diagonal,

  • J2(2) represents a 2×2 Jordan block with 2's on the leading diagonal.

Therefore, our Jordan blocks are given by J1(0)=[0],J2(2)=[2102].

The composition of our Jordan blocks gives the following block diagonal matrix:

J1(0)⊕J2(2)=[000021002]
